lines.en: label day142:
scene dayonefourtwo1
It’s another day in class and...everyone is actually looking at me for some reason.
lines.zh: 又是一天的课，而且……不知道为什么所有人都在看我。

lines.en: In fact, Ayane isn’t even holding anything weird.
lines.zh: 事实上，Ayane 手里连什么奇怪的东西都没拿。

lines.en: Is this what being a normal teacher feels like?
lines.zh: 当一个普通老师就是这个感觉吗？

lines.en: I don’t like it.
lines.zh: 我不喜欢。

lines.en: : Okay. What are you all up to?
lines.zh: : 好了。你们都在搞什么鬼？

lines.en: : Is this one of those class-pranks that students just decide to play on the teacher? There’s not anything weird in my desk is there?
lines.zh: : 这是那种学生突然决定捉弄老师的班级恶作剧吗？我桌子里没放什么奇怪的东西吧？

lines.en: scene dayonefourtwo2
: I’ll check your desk if you want me to, Sensei! I’m really good at finding stuff I’m not supposed to find!
lines.zh: : Sensei，你要是愿意我可以帮你检查桌子！我很擅长找到不该找到的东西！

lines.en: : That...what? What does that even mean?
lines.zh: : 那……什么？这话到底什么意思？

lines.en: : That’s Miku’s way of telling you that everything is normal, Sensei. We’ve all just decided to pay extra attention to you today.
lines.zh: : 那是 Miku 在告诉你一切正常，Sensei。我们只是决定今天多关注你一点。

lines.en: : Yes, I see that. But why?
lines.zh: : 对，我看出来了。可为什么呢？

lines.en: : Is this something Molly did? You guys never acted this way before she was here.
lines.zh: : 这是 Molly 干的吗？她来之前你们从没这样过。

lines.en: scene dayonefourtwo3
: Woah, hold your horses. I haven’t even said anything today!
lines.zh: : 哇哦，别急。我今天可一句话都没说！

lines.en: : Yes, which is suspicious on its own given how much you had to say on your first day.
lines.zh: : 是啊，光凭这一点就很可疑，毕竟你第一天可是有说不完的话。

lines.en: scene dayonefourtwo4
: That’s exactly why I’ve been so calm. You told me it was cool to go over the top but I’m pretty sure I went over the top of the top.
lines.zh: : 这正是我这么安分的原因。你说我可以夸张一点，但我敢肯定我夸张得过头了。

lines.en: : Wouldn’t the top of the top be the-
lines.zh: : 「过头」的上面难道不是——

lines.en: : Actually, never mind. I don’t know what you’re all up to, but I don’t like it.
lines.zh: : 算了，当我没说。我不知道你们在搞什么，但我不喜欢。

lines.en: scene dayonefourtwo5
: Sensei.
lines.zh: : Sensei。

lines.en: : What, Ayane?
lines.zh: : 干嘛，Ayane？

lines.en: : How big is it?
lines.zh: : 它有多大？

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : How big is it? We all want to know.
lines.zh: : 它有多大？我们都想知道。

lines.en: But...she knows exactly how big it is...
lines.zh: 可是……她明明知道它有多大……

lines.en: scene dayonefourtwo6
: I’d also like to know, Sensei! I need to plan accordingly.
lines.zh: : 我也想知道，Sensei！我得做好相应的准备。

lines.en: if day139 == True:
And she knows as well...
lines.zh: 她也知道……

lines.en: else:
Even Chika? What the fuck is going on here?
lines.zh: 连 Chika 也是？这他妈到底是什么情况？

lines.en: : Is this something we’re really going to have a group discussion about?
lines.zh: : 这种事我们真的要当着全班讨论吗？

lines.en: scene dayonefourtwo7
: Well, if we’re all going to be in on it, shouldn’t you at least let everybody know?
lines.zh: : 嗯，既然大家都要参与，你至少该让所有人都知道吧？

lines.en: And now I’m even being betrayed by my [niece].
lines.zh: 现在连我的[niece]都背叛我了。

lines.en: : I’m not gonna lie, I’m normally pretty confident under most circumstances, but...
lines.zh: : 说实话，大多数情况下我都挺自信的，不过……

lines.en: : It’ll be my first time doing something like this, so I’d at least feel a little more comfortable knowing how big it is beforehand.
lines.zh: : 这种事我还是第一次做，所以至少事先知道它有多大，我会稍微安心一点。

lines.en: scene dayonefourtwo8
: Umm...
lines.zh: : 那个……

lines.en: : I know...how big it is...
lines.zh: : 我知道……它有多大……

lines.en: : Even you?!
lines.zh: : 连你也是？！

lines.en: : Well...I’ve seen it before so...
lines.zh: : 嗯……我以前见过它，所以……

lines.en: : Okay, Futaba. I’m going to need you to stay quiet for a minute.
lines.zh: : 好了，Futaba。我需要你安静一分钟。

lines.en: : I understand that some of you may have...seen or experienced things that you probably shouldn’t have, but I want you to know that-
lines.zh: : 我知道你们中有些人可能……看过或经历过一些本不该看、不该经历的事，但我想让你们知道——

lines.en: scene dayonefourtwo9
: They’re not talking about what you think they’re talking about.
lines.zh: : 她们说的不是你以为的那件事。

lines.en: scene dayonefourtwo10
: Wait, how do you know what he’s thinking?
lines.zh: : 等等，你怎么知道他在想什么？

lines.en: : Then what the fuck is everyone talking about?
lines.zh: : 那你们到底他妈的在说什么？

lines.en: scene dayonefourtwo11
: Sensei...
lines.zh: : Sensei……

lines.en: : Woah! We get to curse in here?!
lines.zh: : 哇哦！这儿可以说脏话？！

lines.en: : We’re not supposed to...
lines.zh: : 我们本来不应该……

lines.en: scene dayonefourtwo12
: Fuck yeah.
lines.zh: : 操，太爽了。

lines.en: : Hey, not you. Only I’m allowed to do that.
lines.zh: : 嘿，你不行。只有我能说那个。

lines.en: : Sir, yes sir!
lines.zh: : 遵命，长官！

lines.en: scene dayonefourtwo13
: Hey, can you just tell us how big it is already? Even I’m starting to get curious and I don’t even normally like that type of thing.
lines.zh: : 嘿，你就直接告诉我们它有多大吧？连我都开始好奇了，而我平时根本不喜欢那种事。

lines.en: : Okay, I don’t know how all of you are managing to be so vague and so suggestive at the same time, but can someone please clarify what you’re asking for the size of?
lines.zh: : 好了，我不知道你们是怎么做到既含糊又暧昧的，但谁能说清楚你们问的是「什么」的尺寸？

lines.en: scene dayonefourtwo14
: Oh. They’re talking about the place we’ll be staying when we all go to the beach.
lines.zh: : 哦。她们在说的是我们大家去海边时要住的地方。

lines.en: : I told everybody about it over the[school] message-board.
lines.zh: : 我在[school]的留言板上跟大家都说了。

lines.en: : Okay, I have a few questions.
lines.zh: : 好，我有几个问题。

lines.en: : First...We have a[school] message board?
lines.zh: : 第一……我们有[school]留言板？

lines.en: : Yeah, why?
lines.zh: : 有啊，怎么了？

lines.en: : Second, why are you actually communicating through it? Aren’t those sorts of things boring to [teenager]s?
lines.zh: : 第二，你们为什么真用它来沟通？那种东西对[teenager]来说不是挺无聊的吗？

lines.en: : I guess a little bit. But for organizing group stuff it’s a lot easier than just texting everyone.
lines.zh: : 大概有一点。不过用来组织集体活动的话，比挨个发短信方便多了。

lines.en: : Last question, isn’t it bad talking about a vacation your teacher is taking you on through a site that the rest of the staff can see?
lines.zh: : 最后一个问题，通过一个其他教职工都能看到的网站，讨论老师要带你们去度假的事，难道不要紧吗？

lines.en: : Makoto? Can you back me up on this? That’s a bad idea, right?
lines.zh: : Makoto？你能帮我证明一下吗？那是个坏主意，对吧？

lines.en: scene dayonefourtwo15
: Hmm...I suppose that could be easily misconstrued, yes. Ami was surprisingly smart about it, though. So I don’t think it will be an issue.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我想那确实容易被曲解，对。不过 Ami 处理得出奇地聪明，所以我觉得不会有问题。

lines.en: : Smart? Ami? Are you sure?
lines.zh: : 聪明？Ami？你确定？

lines.en: scene dayonefourtwo16
: Hey!
scene dayonefourtwo17
: Yes, I was surprised as well.
lines.zh: : 是的，我也很惊讶。

lines.en: : Why does everyone think I’m dumb?! I’m smart!
lines.zh: : 为什么大家都觉得我笨？！我很聪明的好吗！

lines.en: : Well then, Ami...How exactly did you manage to tell everyone about a trip to the beach without making me sound like a suspicious individual?
lines.zh: : 那么，Ami……你到底是怎么做到既告诉大家海滩旅行这件事，又没让我听起来像个可疑分子的？

lines.en: scene dayonefourtwo18
: Code language. Instead of saying beach trip, I said ‘educational field trip.’
lines.zh: : 暗号。我不说「海滩旅行」，而是说「教育实地考察」。

lines.en: Oh. Well, I guess that is at least mildly smart. I’m surprised everyone else was able to catch on so easily, though.
lines.zh: 哦。好吧，这至少算是有点小聪明。不过我很惊讶其他人这么轻易就领会了。

lines.en: But, then again, I’m sure that by now, they wouldn’t ever expect me to take them on a trip with any amount of educational value, so it’s all starting to make sense.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，我敢肯定她们现在早就不指望我会带她们去任何有教育价值的地方旅行了，所以一切都说得通了。

lines.en: : So yeah, just tell everybody how big the place is gonna be and-
lines.zh: : 所以啊，你就告诉大家那地方会有多大，然后——

lines.en: : Ami, I haven’t even booked the place yet. I don’t even know if I’ll be able to find one.
lines.zh: : Ami，我连地方都还没订呢。我甚至不知道能不能找得到。

lines.en: scene dayonefourtwo19
: Well...um...we’re talking about the beach in Kumon-mi, right?
lines.zh: : 那个……嗯……我们说的是 Kumon-mi 的那个海滩，对吧？

lines.en: : I mean, I guess so. I haven’t actually laid out any concrete plans yet.
lines.zh: : 我想是吧。我其实还没定下任何具体的计划。

lines.en: : Well, if you do decide on that as where you want to bring us...I’ve been to the inn there with family before.
lines.zh: : 那……如果你决定带我们去那里的话……我以前和家人去过那边的旅馆。

lines.en: : It’s not very large, but I think we should be able to fit everyone in two or three rooms.
lines.zh: : 地方不算大，但我想两三个房间应该能塞下所有人。

lines.en: : Some of us will likely have to sleep on the ground, but...I think it can work.
lines.zh: : 我们中有些人大概得打地铺，不过……我觉得能行。

lines.en: scene dayonefourtwo20
: I don’t mind sleeping on the ground! I can sleep anywhere as long as I have a pillow.
lines.zh: : 我不介意打地铺！只要有枕头，我哪儿都能睡。

lines.en: scene dayonefourtwo21
: UM! I WILL ALSO SLEEP ON THE GROUND!
lines.zh: : 嗯！我也要打地铺！

lines.en: : I LOVE THE GROUND! IT IS MY FAVORITE PLACE TO SLEEP!
lines.zh: : 我爱地板！那是我最喜欢睡觉的地方！

lines.en: : I’m sure it is, Rin.
lines.zh: : 你肯定爱，Rin。

lines.en: : I refuse to sleep on the ground. I’ll sleep in the bed with Ami and Ayane.
lines.zh: : 我拒绝打地铺。我要和 Ami、Ayane 睡床上。

lines.en: : Sensei can sleep on the bus.
lines.zh: : Sensei 可以睡大巴上。

lines.en: scene dayonefourtwo22
: MY Sensei? Sleeping on a bus? Are you out of your mind?
lines.zh: : 我的 Sensei？睡大巴上？你疯了吗？

lines.en: : He’s going to sleep in the bed with me. You can sleep on the bus.
lines.zh: : 他要和我睡床上。你睡大巴去。

lines.en: : If he’s actually going to be sleeping in the bed with you then yes, I will sleep on the bus.
lines.zh: : 如果他真要和你睡床上，那好，我去睡大巴。

lines.en: : You’re all still getting a little ahead of yourselves. It will probably be a while before I can even book anything.
lines.zh: : 你们有点太超前了。我大概还得一阵子才能订到地方。

lines.en: scene dayonefourtwo23
: Would you like me to handle that for you, Sensei? I’m already doing pretty much everything else, so one more thing won’t bother me.
lines.zh: : 需要我帮您处理吗，Sensei？其他的事基本都是我在做，再多一件也无所谓。

lines.en: : I mean, if you’re okay with it, sure.
lines.zh: : 我是说，如果你不介意的话，当然好。

lines.en: scene dayonefourtwo24
: Hehe...It’s kind of like I’m becoming your secretary too~
lines.zh: : 呵呵……感觉我也快变成你的秘书了~

lines.en: scene dayonefourtwo25
: Pardon my interjection, Master, but we Irish folk don’t typically handle the sun all too well.
lines.zh: : 请原谅我插一句，主人，但我们爱尔兰人通常不太扛得住太阳。

lines.en: : Would you be willing to find the time in your busy schedule to nurse me back to health should I happen to fall ill?
lines.zh: : 万一我晒病了，您愿意在百忙之中抽出时间照顾我康复吗？

lines.en: : Just wear sunscreen, Molly.
lines.zh: : 涂防晒霜就行了，Molly。

lines.en: : But I don’t have any sunscreen.
lines.zh: : 可我没有防晒霜。

lines.en: : Then go buy some.
lines.zh: : 那就去买。

lines.en: : But I don’t have any money.
lines.zh: : 可我没钱。

lines.en: : Then bring a parasol or something.
lines.zh: : 那就带把遮阳伞什么的。

lines.en: scene dayonefourtwo26
: I will bring two in order to compensate for how weak and sensitive my European skin is.
lines.zh: : 我会带两把，以弥补我欧洲皮肤有多么脆弱敏感。

lines.en: : Sounds great.
lines.zh: : 听起来不错。

lines.en: : So, can we go back to normal now that I’ve been forced into confirming that I’ll take you all to the beach?
lines.zh: : 那么，既然我被迫确认了会带你们去海滩，我们能恢复正常了吗？

lines.en: scene dayonefourtwo27
: Oh, actually, do you mind if I come talk to you for a second, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 哦，对了，Sensei，介意我过来跟你说两句吗？

lines.en: : There’s something I want to...run by you if that’s okay.
lines.zh: : 有件事我想……跟你商量一下，可以吗？

lines.en: : Huh? Yeah. That’s fine.
lines.zh: : 哈？行啊。没问题。

lines.en: scene black
Rin shyly walks over to my desk and brings her voice to a near-whisper.
lines.zh: Rin 害羞地走到我的桌子旁，把声音压得近乎耳语。

lines.en: : Do you...mind if we actually talk in the hall?
lines.zh: : 你……介意我们去走廊上谈吗？

lines.en: scene dayonefourtwo28
: Sorry for calling you out here in the middle of class like that. You don't think it seemed weird, do you?
lines.zh: : 抱歉上课到一半把你叫出来。你觉得这看起来不奇怪吧？

lines.en: : Weird? Not really. Maybe a little unusual, but I doubt anyone really thought anything of it.
lines.zh: : 奇怪？不至于。也许有点不寻常，但我怀疑没人会多想。

lines.en: : R-Right...
lines.zh: : 是、是吗……

lines.en: : Well, umm...
lines.zh: : 那么，嗯……

lines.en: scene dayonefourtwo29
: I’m...not really great when it comes to spending the night anywhere other than my dorm.
lines.zh: : 我……不太擅长在宿舍以外的地方过夜。

lines.en: : Do you mind if I ask why?
lines.zh: : 介意我问为什么吗？

lines.en: scene dayonefourtwo30
: That’s exactly why I called you out here.
lines.zh: : 这正是我把你叫出来的原因。

lines.en: : So like, you know how I’m supposed to take medication and stuff to keep me from getting all blaaaaah or whatever?
lines.zh: : 就是，你知道我要吃药什么的，好让自己不会变得整天……呜呃呃之类的吧？

lines.en: : Of course.
lines.zh: : 当然。

lines.en: To be fair, it’s kind of hard to forget after I saw her in that delirious state a while back.
lines.zh: 说句公道话，前阵子见过她那副神志不清的样子之后，很难忘掉。

lines.en: : Well, being somewhere I’m not used to normally freaks me out a bit. I think it’s an anxiety thing.
lines.zh: : 嗯，待在不熟悉的地方通常会让我有点慌。我觉得是焦虑之类的。

lines.en: : And it’s not like I’m gonna bail on the trip or anything like that. I think it sounds fun.
lines.zh: : 而且我也不是要退出旅行什么的。我觉得听起来挺好玩的。

lines.en: : But if I start acting all...you know...weird...
lines.zh: : 但如果我开始变得……你知道的……很怪……

lines.en: scene dayonefourtwo31
: Would you mind...maybe trying to calm me down a bit?
lines.zh: : 你介意……试着让我平静下来吗？

lines.en: : Absolutely. How would I do that, though? You weren’t really that...consolable the last time I saw you in poor condition.
lines.zh: : 当然。不过我要怎么做呢？上次我看到你状态不好的时候，你可没那么好哄。

lines.en: scene dayonefourtwo32
: I don’t know, man. Just...sit with me and pat my head or something. Preferably away from everyone else.
lines.zh: : 我不知道啊，老兄。就……坐在我旁边，摸摸我的头什么的。最好离其他人远一点。

lines.en: : Even Chika?
lines.zh: : 连 Chika 也要避开？

lines.en: : Definitely Chika. Chika more than anyone. I can’t have her knowing I can get all weird like that.
lines.zh: : 尤其是 Chika。比谁都要避开她。我不能让她知道我会变成那样。

lines.en: : I’d never have a chance if she knew that side of me.
lines.zh: : 要是她知道了那样的我，我就一点机会都没有了。

lines.en: if chikadorm20 == True:
: That’s not true. Chika’s one of the most caring people I know. She’d never think less of you over something like that.
lines.zh: : 那不是真的。Chika 是我认识的最会关心人的人之一。她绝不会因为你那样而看轻你。

lines.en: Rin stays quiet for a moment. I notice her fingers beginning to pluck at loose threads on her sweater before she locks her eyes with mine again.
lines.zh: Rin 沉默了片刻。我注意到她的手指开始揪着毛衣上松脱的线头，然后她又和我对上了视线。

lines.en: scene dayonefourtwo33
: Sounds like...you’re getting to know her pretty well, huh?...
lines.zh: : 听起来……你跟她已经挺熟了，嗯？……

lines.en: else:
: Do you really think she’s the type of person to just cut ties with you after finding out something like that?
lines.zh: : 你真觉得她是那种知道那种事就会跟你断绝关系的人吗？

lines.en: : Well, no...But that doesn’t mean I’m comfortable with her knowing.
lines.zh: : 嗯，不……可那也不代表我愿意让她知道。

lines.en: scene dayonefourtwo34
: Um, anyway! We should probably be getting back to class, right? People might think it’s serious if we’re out here for any longer.
lines.zh: : 那个，总之！我们大概该回教室了吧？再待久一点，别人可能会以为很严重。

lines.en: : This...is kind of serious, though. Right?
lines.zh: : 不过这……确实挺严重的吧？对吧？

lines.en: scene dayonefourtwo35
: What? No! No way! Just a little heads up in case I get a little panicky. It’s nothing worth losing sleep over.
lines.zh: : 什么？不！才没有！只是提前跟你打个招呼，万一我有点慌呢。不值得为此失眠。

lines.en: : I just...wanted you to know. That’s all.
lines.zh: : 我只是……想让你知道。就这样。

lines.en: scene black
Rin and I walk back into class and she immediately retreats to her desk as if none of this ever happened.
lines.zh: Rin 和我走回教室，她立刻退回自己的座位，就好像这一切从未发生过。

lines.en: The rest of the[school] day carries on normally.
lines.zh: [school]这一天剩下的时间照常过去了。

lines.en: Except...
lines.zh: 除了……

lines.en: Now I have to figure out how I’m going to handle going on a mini-vacation with an entire class of [high_school] girls.
lines.zh: 现在我得想办法，怎么带着一整班[high_school]女生去度个小假。

lines.en: $ rin_love += 1
$ day142 = True
Rin’s affection has increased to [rin_love]!
lines.zh: Rin 的好感度提升到了 [rin_love]！

lines.en: jump afterschoolevent
